# A disqualified account is frequently somebody else's ideal customer — …

> A disqualified account is frequently somebody else's ideal customer — route it, do not merely drop it.
 Referral relationships are built out of the accounts you correctly refuse, and they cost nothing because you were not going to win them. Treating disqualification as deletion throws away the only asset a rejected account still has.
